item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Which of the two attached pictures should be upscaled?

item.title: Resolve the Upscale Target
item.tests: Asks which attachment the user means, then upscales only the selected picture without guessing or processing both.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions.

must_haves: The final deliverable is an upscaled version of lake-small.jpg, following clarification.
The lake, mountains, trees, clouds, and their arrangement remain faithful to the selected source.
The delivered image has larger pixel dimensions than lake-small.jpg, not merely a renamed copy.
The full original framing and aspect ratio are preserved.
Only one edited image is delivered; the dog photo is not included or blended into it.

turns.text: Upscale it please. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Nothing has run, and no credits have been spent.

You attached **two images**—the blurry dog and the lake. Which one did you mean, or do you want both?

**Lowest-cost upscale option:** **2×, Preserve mode**. This is the free-plan-compatible option; 4× requires a paid plan. The upscaler lists costs of **25–200 credits**, with Preserve using the lowest cost multiplier. However, I don’t have an exact quote or balance-check tool available, so I can’t guarantee the charge before running it.

- **Cheaper:** Upscale just one image, using 2× Preserve rather than Balanced or Creative.
- **Smaller:** 2× is the smallest supported upscale. There’s no smaller upscale setting listed.
- **Shorter:** These are still images, so duration doesn’t affect cost.
- **No credits:** Ordinary resizing in a local image editor costs no Magic Hour credits, but won’t recover missing detail. The dog’s heavy blur also limits what AI can faithfully restore.

I won’t submit either image without your confirmation of the cost and selection.
dialog.user: The lake one, lake-small.jpg. Keep the whole picture and its original proportions, with no added text—ok, go ahead with that 2× Preserve option.

turns.agent:
The 2× Preserve upscale was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was generated, and no credits were spent.

I haven’t tried another option. For a no-credit alternative, resize the lake image locally to **1024 × 614 px**, with aspect ratio locked. That keeps the whole picture and adds no text, though ordinary resizing won’t restore detail.
